id: urn:datacontract:operations:gold.service_order_economics
name: gold.service_order_economics
version: 2.0.0
status: active
domain: operations
dataProduct: Service profitability
description:
  purpose: Plan versus actual cost, cost variance and gross margin for every non-cancelled service order.
  usage: Service profitability dashboard; customer value.
  limitations: Costs come only from validated (non-quarantined) labor and material lines.
tags: [gold, kpi]
team:

  - {username: sam.samplewood, role: data_steward}
slaProperties:
  - {property: latency, value: 3, unit: d, element: gold.service_order_economics.opened_on}
customProperties:
  - {property: dataClassification, value: confidential}
  - property: changePolicy
    value:
      versioning: semver
      breaking: [remove a column, rename a column, change a logical type, make a column required, change the primary key, raise the classification]
      nonBreaking: [add an optional column, add or relax a quality rule, improve descriptions]
      breakingRequires: major version bump and Data Owner approval (raci.change_data_contract)
      deprecationNoticeDays: 30
schema:
  - name: service_order_economics
    physicalName: gold.service_order_economics
    physicalType: table
    description: One row per non-cancelled service order.
    properties:
      - {name: order_id, logicalType: string, physicalType: VARCHAR, primaryKey: true, primaryKeyPosition: 1,
         businessName: Service order, description: Order number.}
      - {name: customer_id, logicalType: string, physicalType: VARCHAR, required: true, businessName: Customer, description: Buying company.}
      - {name: asset_id, logicalType: string, physicalType: VARCHAR, required: true, businessName: Asset, description: Asset serviced.}
      - {name: site, logicalType: string, physicalType: VARCHAR, required: true, businessName: Site, description: Site of the asset.}
      - {name: asset_type, logicalType: string, physicalType: VARCHAR, businessName: Asset type, description: Equipment family.}
      - {name: service_type, logicalType: string, physicalType: VARCHAR, businessName: Service type, description: Nature of work.}
      - {name: status, logicalType: string, physicalType: VARCHAR, businessName: Order status, description: OPEN or CLOSED.,
         quality: [{name: no_cancelled_orders, type: library, rule: validValues, arguments: {values: [OPEN, CLOSED]}}]}
      - {name: opened_on, logicalType: date, physicalType: DATE, required: true, businessName: Order open date, description: Creation date.}
      - {name: closed_on, logicalType: date, physicalType: DATE, businessName: Order close date, description: Completion date.}
      - {name: planned_hours, logicalType: integer, physicalType: INTEGER, description: Quoted labor hours.}
      - {name: actual_hours, logicalType: number, physicalType: DOUBLE, businessName: Labor hours, description: Hours booked.}
      - {name: planned_cost, logicalType: number, physicalType: DOUBLE, businessName: Planned cost, description: Quoted cost.}
      - {name: actual_labor_cost, logicalType: number, physicalType: DOUBLE, businessName: Actual labor cost, description: Labor cost incurred.}
      - {name: actual_material_cost, logicalType: number, physicalType: DOUBLE, businessName: Actual material cost,
         description: Material cost incurred.}
      - {name: actual_cost, logicalType: number, physicalType: DOUBLE, required: true, businessName: Actual cost, description: Total cost incurred.,
         quality: [{name: actual_cost_non_negative, type: library, rule: range, arguments: {min: 0}}]}
      - {name: cost_variance_pct, logicalType: number, physicalType: DOUBLE, businessName: Cost variance, description: Cost overrun in percent.}
      - {name: price, logicalType: number, physicalType: DOUBLE, required: true, businessName: Order price, description: Billable amount.}
      - {name: gross_margin, logicalType: number, physicalType: DOUBLE, businessName: Gross margin, description: Price minus actual cost.}
      - {name: gross_margin_pct, logicalType: number, physicalType: DOUBLE, businessName: Gross margin %, description: Margin over price.,
         quality: [{name: margin_pct_plausible, type: library, rule: range, arguments: {min: -100, max: 100}, severity: warning,
                    description: Margins outside ±100% usually mean a costing or pricing error.}]}
    quality:
      - name: margin_definition_holds
        type: sql
        query: "SELECT count(*) FROM {object} WHERE abs(gross_margin - (price - actual_cost)) > 0.02"
        mustBe: 0
        dimension: consistency
        description: Gross margin equals price minus actual cost on every row (glossary formula).
      - name: labor_cost_reconciles
        type: sql
        query: >-
          SELECT abs((SELECT sum(actual_labor_cost) FROM {object}) - (SELECT sum(l.hours * t.hourly_cost)
          FROM silver.labor_entries l JOIN silver.technicians t USING (technician_id)
          WHERE l.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM {object})))
        mustBeLessThan: 1
        dimension: accuracy
        description: Gold labor cost reconciles with silver hours × rates within one currency unit.
      - name: material_cost_reconciles
        type: sql
        query: >-
          SELECT abs((SELECT sum(actual_material_cost) FROM {object}) - (SELECT sum(line_cost)
          FROM silver.material_issues WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM {object})))
        mustBeLessThan: 1
        dimension: accuracy
        description: Gold material cost reconciles with silver issue lines.

apiVersion: v3.0.2
kind: DataContract
id: urn:datacontract:operations:silver.service_orders
name: silver.service_orders
version: 1.2.0
status: active
domain: operations
dataProduct: Service operations
description:
  purpose: Validated service orders. Orders failing a blocking rule are quarantined with the reason.
  usage: Base of all service economics and site KPIs. Price and planned costs are confidential columns; the rest is internal so field teams can plan work.
  limitations: Cancelled orders are kept here and excluded in gold.
tags: [silver, transactions]
team:
  - {username: riley.placeholder, role: data_owner}
  - {username: sam.samplewood, role: data_steward}
slaProperties:
  - {property: latency, value: 3, unit: d, element: silver.service_orders.opened_on}
customProperties:
  - {property: dataClassification, value: internal}
  - property: changePolicy
    value:
      versioning: semver
      breaking: [remove a column, rename a column, change a logical type, make a column required, change the primary key, raise the classification]
      nonBreaking: [add an optional column, add or relax a quality rule, improve descriptions]
      breakingRequires: major version bump and Data Owner approval (raci.change_data_contract)
      deprecationNoticeDays: 30
schema:
  - name: service_orders
    physicalName: silver.service_orders
    physicalType: table
    description: One row per service order.
    properties:
      - {name: order_id, logicalType: string, physicalType: VARCHAR, primaryKey: true, primaryKeyPosition: 1,
         businessName: Service order, description: Order number SO-nnnnnn.,
         quality: [{name: order_id_format, type: library, rule: pattern, arguments: {pattern: '^SO-\d{6}$'}}]}
      - {name: customer_id, logicalType: string, physicalType: VARCHAR, required: true, businessName: Customer,
         description: Buying company.,
         quality: [{name: customer_id_exists, type: library, rule: references, arguments: {table: silver.customers, column: customer_id}}]}
      - {name: asset_id, logicalType: string, physicalType: VARCHAR, required: true, businessName: Asset,
         description: Asset serviced.,
         quality: [{name: asset_id_exists, type: library, rule: references, arguments: {table: silver.assets, column: asset_id}}]}
      - {name: service_type, logicalType: string, physicalType: VARCHAR, businessName: Service type, description: Nature of work.,
         quality: [{name: service_type_valid, type: library, rule: validValues,
                    arguments: {values: [Preventive maintenance, Corrective maintenance, Installation, Inspection]}}]}
      - {name: opened_on, logicalType: date, physicalType: DATE, required: true, businessName: Order open date, description: Creation date.}
      - {name: closed_on, logicalType: date, physicalType: DATE, businessName: Order close date, description: Completion date.,
         quality: [{name: closed_after_opened, type: library, rule: expression,
                    arguments: {sql: closed_on IS NULL OR closed_on >= opened_on}, description: An order cannot close before it opens.}]}
      - {name: status, logicalType: string, physicalType: VARCHAR, businessName: Order status, description: Normalised status.,
         quality: [{name: status_valid, type: library, rule: validValues, arguments: {values: [OPEN, CLOSED, CANCELLED]}}]}
      - {name: planned_hours, logicalType: integer, physicalType: INTEGER, description: Quoted labor hours.,
         quality: [{name: planned_hours_non_negative, type: library, rule: range, arguments: {min: 0}}]}
      - {name: planned_labor_cost, logicalType: number, physicalType: DOUBLE, classification: confidential, description: Quoted labor cost.,
         quality: [{name: planned_labor_cost_non_negative, type: library, rule: range, arguments: {min: 0}}]}
      - {name: planned_material_cost, logicalType: number, physicalType: DOUBLE, classification: confidential, description: Quoted material cost.,
         quality: [{name: planned_material_cost_non_negative, type: library, rule: range, arguments: {min: 0}}]}
      - {name: price, logicalType: number, physicalType: DOUBLE, required: true, classification: confidential, businessName: Order price,
         description: Billable amount excluding tax.,
         quality: [{name: price_non_negative, type: library, rule: range, arguments: {min: 0}}]}
    quality:
      - {name: order_volume, type: library, rule: rowCount, arguments: {min: 100}}
      - name: closed_orders_have_date
        type: sql
        query: "SELECT count(*) FROM {object} WHERE status = 'CLOSED' AND closed_on IS NULL"
        mustBe: 0
        dimension: completeness
        severity: warning
